recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Any further work about the later FHIR-49722 warning-invariant request should be evaluated in the FHIR Extension Pack, not as a FHIR-core source edit for FHIR-12644.
issue_request: FHIR-12644 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU2 change request to enhance the translation extension by binding the lang slice to a language value set, allowing content as string or markdown, explicitly allowing use on markdown elements, and adding a rule that the translation type must match the translated element type.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 11190. In the converted git history, commit 9e81a801abf6308133485c9f025ba09c5d8c9ef3 is git-svn build@11190 and changed the old general extensions spreadsheet from string to string | markdown for translation content while adding the type-match comment. Related FHIR-10650 was applied nearby for translatable ElementDefinition/tooling behavior.
additional_context: The translation StructureDefinition no longer lives in the FHIR-core source tree. Commit dd468d4f17 removed old extension material from R5 core source, and the current authoritative translation definition is in the FHIR Extension Pack. Current core source links to that external extension from languages.html and marks both string and markdown as do-translations in fhir.ini. Later FHIR-49722 clarified translation-on-code and type-match guidance in the Extension Pack without reversing the FHIR-12644 string/markdown or markdown-context decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The Extension Pack translation definition has string and markdown contexts, a required lang binding to all-languages with languages as a starter set, string and markdown content choices, and type-match guidance. FHIR-core already points readers to that definition and identifies string/markdown as translation-capable, so duplicating prose or restoring a moved core extension source would be inappropriate.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-12644 cites this ElementDefinition/translatable-tooling issue; it was used as background but not independently audited here.
Later FHIR-extensions clarification for translation-on-code and type-match guidance; it does not require a FHIR-core change for FHIR-12644.
